blocks.zh: 5.1 Part 606 & 607 — Blood Manufacturing CGMPs & Registration 5.1 Part 606 & 607 — 血液製造 CGMP 與登記
核心概念解析 Key Concepts
血液 CGMP 的特殊性： Part 606 的 CGMP 要求與 Parts 210/211 並行但部分不同——血液中心（Blood Centers）不是製藥廠，但需要有同等水準的品質控制。Part 606 的偏差報告（§ 606.171）是血液製品特有的，與 § 600.14 互不重疊。
blocks.en: What is special about blood CGMP: The CGMP requirements of Part 606 run in parallel with Parts 210/211 but differ in some respects: blood centers are not pharmaceutical manufacturers, yet they need quality control at an equivalent level. The deviation reporting requirement of Part 606 (§ 606.171) is specific to blood products and does not overlap with § 600.14.

blocks.zh: CDMO 相關性： 如果 CDMO 承接血漿衍生製品（如白蛋白、免疫球蛋白、凝血因子）的後處理或充填，其原料藥（血漿）供應鏈必須符合 Part 606 的 CGMP——CDMO 需在供應商審計中驗證。
blocks.en: Relevance to a CDMO: If a CDMO takes on downstream processing or filling of plasma-derived products (such as albumin, immune globulin and coagulation factors), the supply chain for the starting material (plasma) must comply with the CGMP of Part 606, and the CDMO needs to verify this through supplier audits.

blocks.zh: ★ Part 607 的雙年度登記是血液業特有要求——雖然 CDMO 不直接受此管轄，但理解登記制度有助於評估血液原料供應商的監管狀態。
blocks.en: ★ The biennial registration under Part 607 is a requirement specific to the blood industry. Although a CDMO is not directly subject to it, understanding the registration system helps in assessing the regulatory status of blood raw material suppliers.

blocks.zh: 如果 Amaran 要承接 Factor VIII 凝血因子製品的充填，需要了解哪些額外法規要求（除了現有的 Parts 600、601、610）？
blocks.en: If Amaran were to take on filling of a Factor VIII coagulation factor product, what additional regulatory requirements (beyond the existing Parts 600, 601 and 610) would it need to understand?
